title: 12.4 Volumes of Prisms and Cylinders

icans: I can find the volume of a prism or a cylinder.
I can find a missing dimension from a volume.
I can use the scale factor of similar solids to compare their volumes.

vocab: the number of cubic units ____________ in the interior of a solid
if two solids have the same height and the same __________________ area at every level, then they have the same volume
two solids of the same type with equal ratios of ________________ linear measures
